messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Deployment rollout 'inference-service-v2' canary (us-east-1a) failing health checks — 4/5 pods CrashLoopBackOff. Error: readiness probe failed. Paging on-call: @sam and @oncall-rotation
sam: oncall here, looking. tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre. Can someone paste the pod logs? what was changed in this rollout?
jess: I rolled the canary 12m ago. Main change: readiness probe path and added a small initContainer to download model artifacts. flag 'enable-new-kvcache' = true for 10% canary. no other infra changes.
michael: I'm seeing node drain events around the same time in us-east-1a — drain-job triggered for kube-upgrades? logs show eviction spikes.
leah: pod logs (tail) from inference-service-v2-canary-1:
```
E0424 15:32:10 server.go:87] readiness check failed: handler returned 500
2026-04-24T15:32:11Z error opening model shard: permission denied
```
sam: permission denied on model shard suggests initContainer didn't populate artifacts or mounted PVC wrong. jess, did the initContainer mount a new volume or change the mountPath?
jess: yeah, modified initContainer to write to /models/artifacts and changed mount to emptyDir in the canary manifest by mistake (should have been pvc-models). ugh.
ops-bot: Recommend hotfix: rollback canary or patch mount to pvc-models. Also we have HPA firing scale events; canary failing triggers autoscaler thrash. Suggest cordon the node with draining in progress to stop further evictions.
michael: I'll cordon the problematic node(s) now — `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-42.us-east-1a` and scale the canary down to 0 for safety: `kubectl scale deploy inference-service-v2 --replicas=0 -n prod --selector=canary=true`.
sam: go for rollback first — `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service-v2 -n prod --to-revision=1` then pause rollout. Also disable feature flag `enable-new-kvcache` in flags-service (internal API): `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/disable?flag=enable-new-kvcache&env=prod` — folks, do that asap.
jess: disabling flag now. response 200.
leah: rollback started — rollout status shows all old pods coming up. HPA is stabilizing. node cordoned. ops-bot: mark incident as mitigated if service health OK for 5 min.
sam: initial customer impact: small subset of canary routed requests (~2% of traffic in us-east) saw 500s for ~11 minutes. No global outage. Notifying Customer Success for any suspicious tickets. tagging #product-impact.
oncall-rotation: Handoff checklist: create follow-up ticket (ENG-9821) for fix (restore correct PVC mount, add CI check for initContainer mounts, add feature-flag gating for storage changes). assign to @jess. schedule postmortem if impact > 15m.
jess: filing fix PR now, adding unit/integration test for mount path. will follow up with a patch and a smaller canary after tests.
sam: thanks all. leaving incident open for 10m to watch metrics; if stable we'll close and document RCA. :white_check_mark:
